_provenance.label: SYNTHETIC. Faulted reads of a transaction (ledger, switch, destination) for the Evidence read path (EVD-05, the hostility-proxy part, A717; REQ-CTX-008).
_provenance.method: The real hostility proxy (benchmark/hostility_proxy, config/routes.standin.json), over a real connection, with one fault from a real fault plan (seed 17), in front of a test-only upstream that answers in the stand-in's wire shape. Nothing is written by hand. An exchange with outcome dropped had no answer; hold_ms is the hold the effect asks for.
